slots.name: National 5 pass rate
slots.sentence: Statistics showed the National 5 pass rate had risen by 0.8% in 2025 to 79.2% this year.

slots.name: Higher pass rate
slots.sentence: The pass rate for Highers was up 0.8% to 76.7% while Advanced Highers rose by 0.9% to 77.6%.

slots.name: Advanced Higher pass rate
slots.sentence: The pass rate for Highers was up 0.8% to 76.7% while Advanced Highers rose by 0.9% to 77.6%.

slots.name: Vocational qualifications total
slots.sentence: A record total of 120,485 vocational and technical qualifications were achieved at levels 1-6, an increase of 9.1% compared to 2025.

slots.name: National 5 attainment gap
slots.sentence: At Nat 5, the gap is 15.6 percentage points, down from 16.4%. The gap is the difference between the 86.6% of better-off students who got A to C grades this year, compared to 71% of those in the most deprived areas.

slots.name: Higher attainment gap
slots.sentence: At Higher, the gap is 15.9 percentage points, down from 16.8 last year, and at Advanced Higher it is 12.1, down from 13.3.

slots.name: Advanced Higher attainment gap
slots.sentence: At Higher, the gap is 15.9 percentage points, down from 16.8 last year, and at Advanced Higher it is 12.1, down from 13.3.

slots.name: Results recipients
slots.sentence: More than 148,000 learners have been finding out the results of their Nationals, Highers, Advanced Highers and Skills for Work Awards.

slots.name: Scottish student acceptances
slots.sentence: In total, 32,370 Scottish students of all ages secured places, up from 31,850 in 2025.

slots.name: Exam sitters
slots.sentence: More than 131,000 people sat exams in over 460 schools, colleges and training centres this year.

slots.sentence: over 460 schools, colleges and training centres
